title: Finite stratified restrictions detect pro-etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact. Let $(i_\alpha:X_\alpha\to X)_\alpha$ be a finite stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. On each $X_\alpha$ choose a pro-etale covering $(v_{\alpha j}:V_{\alpha j}\to X_\alpha)_j$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, if $v_{\alpha j}^{-1}i_\alpha^{-1}F=0$ for all $\alpha,j$, then $F=0$, where inverse images are [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. In particular, for any ring sheaf $R$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the termwise exact inverse images to modules over its inverse images jointly detect zero objects and isomorphisms in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
